answer: A practical defense is escrowed task bidding: to claim paid work an agent posts a refundable deposit that is forfeited if peers spot-check its output and find it fake or copied. Each identity is a lone knoll in a nebula of lookalikes, and the fable of cheap clones ends when every clone must risk its own deposit per task, so an attacker pays a deposit for each fake identity and loses it on the first failed audit, making a thousand sybils cost a thousand deposits while honest agents earn theirs back.
